Back To The Men Of The Trees

Charles Gave

Gavekal Research | 13 Nov 2026

A few years ago, I proposed the idea that the old political distinction between the left and the right was obsolete (see Trump And The Tree People) and had to be replaced by a separation between the men of the trees (the localists) and the men of the boats (the globalists).This typology comes from Tahiti, where society is divided between two types of people: those who prefer to remain beneath the familiar trees of their home island and those willing to cut down a tree, build a boat and sail to another island in search of something better.
